content.title: What’s open and closed Easter 2026: Store hours and delivery services
content.text: COLUMBUS, Ohio (WCMH) — Easter Sunday, a major Christian holiday observing the resurrection of Jesus Christ, falls on April 5 this year. The date moves annually, with the holiday falling on the first Sunday after the first full moon that occurs on or after the start of spring. Traditional Easter plans include events such as sunrise church services, egg hunts and formal brunches, with many families spending time together. While Easter is not considered a federal U.S. holiday, several retailers close or have modified hours to give employees time off. See the list below to find out what will be open or closed on Easter Sunday. Which grocery stores are open on Easter 2026? • Giant Eagle, holiday hours, open until 4 p.m.; check listings for details• Kroger, regular store hours, pharmacies and clinics will be closed• Meijer• Trader Joe’s, open regular hours• Walmart• Whole Foods, modified hours 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Easter What stores are open on Easter 2026? • Cabela’s• CVS• Dollar General• Home Depot, 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.• Ikea• Menards, open until 6 p.m.• Petco• PetSmart• REI, noon to 6 p.m.• Walgreens, some locations closed, check individual store information Which grocery stores are closed on Easter 2026? • Aldi stores are closed on Easter Sunday• Costco• Sam’s Club is closed on Easter• Target: all stores are closed on Easter Sunday What stores are closed on Easter 2026? • Best Buy• Dick’s Sporting Goods• JCPenney• Kohl’s• Lowe’s• Macy’s• Marshalls• Michaels• Nordstrom, Nordstrom Rack• TJ Maxx Are malls open on Easter Sunday 2026? • Easton Town Center is closed on Easter Sunday.• Polaris Fashion Place is closed on Easter Sunday.• Tanger Outlets, select stores at Tanger Columbus, will be open from 11 am to 6 p.m. Individual retailer hours may vary. Will packages be delivered on Easter? FedEx and FedEx Freight will be closed and packages will not be delivered on Easter. FedEx Offices will have modified hours. FedEx’s Custom Critical and Logistics arms will remain open. Easter is a UPS holiday. There will be no UPS pickup or delivery service. The UPS Store locations may be closed. Check with your local store for specific hours of operation. UPS Express Critical service (provided by Marken) is available 7/24/365. Call 1-800-714-8779 or visit marken.com. Amazon delivery services and warehouses operate as usual on Easter. Amazon’s delivery drivers will deliver packages, but items shipped using UPS or FedEx could be delayed. Does trash collection day change after Easter? No, since Easter falls on Sunday, it does not impact Columbus’s trash collection schedule. The color-coded collection schedule will not rotate one day forward until Memorial Day on Monday, May 25, 2026. Rumpke will also continue to collect recycling and yard waste on schedule. Will the library be open on Easter? All Columbus Metropolitan Library locations will be closed on Easter Sunday. Are buses running? Is parking free? The Central Ohio Transit Authority will operate its regular Sunday service. Easter is not one of the 11 holidays listed with free parking; however, because the holiday is on a Sunday, meters will not be operating in Columbus.
